note: Renames ingestion lanes/ to pipelines/ with single-word folder names (session-replay -> sessionreplay, errortracking, clientwarnings) and updates imports.
Replaces inline skill creation with skill_services.create_skill and maps typed duplicate-name, file-path and file-limit errors; drops the generic IntegrityError fallback.
Replaces the git diff grep step with a dataModeling filter in the existing paths-filter step and gates the deployment on its output.
Adds @memlab/lens to package.json and dynamically imports it, removing the CDN script loader, SRI hash and window global.
Starts the inbox onboarding workflow on TASKS_TASK_QUEUE instead of MAX_AI_TASK_QUEUE and moves workflow into slack_app package.
Moves chart drill-down navigation into a scannerOverviewLogic drillIntoObservations action with tests; component only dispatches it.
Renames the metric outcome label to dropped_billing_limited and centralizes the billing-limit check on the capture error.
Only rewrites the module docstring and keeps the list endpoint read-only; the get_or_create call still uses all_teams, not for_team.
Drops the type-order sort in the picker, renders defaultEvaluationTemplates directly and reorders templates.ts.
Coerces request count and web search count operands through numeric helpers in request-costs and web-search-costs, with tests.
Hoists nested tracker dataclass and helper functions out of cdc_extract_activity to module level with a shared context dataclass, not a class.
Changes cyclotron retry API to take scheduledAt instead of delayMs and removes computeDelayMs.
Extracts a context-menu helper, hardcodes placeholder and keys loading by kind; the document.querySelector focus coupling remains.
Uses an exported fetchDefaultReleaseConditions helper from defaultReleaseConditionsLogic instead of the hardcoded URL.
Uses cached team project_id in remote config; the duplicated PAK last-used recording block is untouched.
Moves the discard-prompt handling into a dashboardLogic cancelEditMode action; component just calls it.
Adds resolveDefaultReleaseConditions and uses it at both call sites, collapsing the duplicated fetch-else-warn blocks.
Adds dependency_edges to DependencyCopyGraph recorded during the DFS and reads them instead of rebuilding adjacency.
Teaches update_cache to accept pre-built data and calls it with the config, removing the hand-rolled metric emission.
Adds a shared clone_experiment helper used by both duplicate_experiment and copy_experiment_to_project.
